what: đèn cột xanh hai tay, the blue lamp pole of the park with a frame of two arms at the top
uses: Plan 0026, R9: the lamp poles of the sidewalk of the park and of the walk of the sea (data/showcase/bai_truoc.json, lamp_rows, the kind blue_double), about 36 m apart.

photos.author: Lam Tr Th
photos.shows: The walk of the park by the low wall of the beach: a blue lamp pole with a frame of two arms and a lamp head at the top, a white globe on a curved arm and a horn speaker at about half its height, a woman and a child near it; a stone sculpture, leaning coconut palms, a Norfolk pine, a black post with white globes far behind.

photos.author: Tuong Lam Photos
photos.shows: From a drone over the south end of Bãi Trước, to the north: Khách sạn Bưu điện (12 storeys) with its pool, Cảng vụ, Quang Trung with the median of Norfolk pines and the curb of red and white bands, the square of the south end of the park with Norfolk pines and flags, the walk of the sea with the low wall, the boats of the bay, Núi Lớn.

photos.date: 2019-04-30 (in the file name of the photo)
photos.author: Tuổi Trẻ
photos.shows: The beach of Bãi Trước full of people at the end of the afternoon, to the south: people on the sand and in the water, swim rings, a light blue lamp pole, Khách sạn Bưu điện, the tower of Khách sạn Hoa Tiêu, the stepped block, the orange tile roof, the hill Núi Nhỏ.

photos.author: VnExpress
photos.shows: The south part of the beach full of swimmers at the end of the afternoon: the low wall with balusters in sections on the sloped stone sea wall, a stair down to the sand in a gap between two sections, swim rings, light blue lamp poles behind the palms.

checks: Views: front, side, three quarters, far (60 m).
The height to the top of the frame is 10.9 m ± 0.5 m.
The frame of the two arms is 3.0 m ± 0.5 m from end to end, with a lamp head at each end.
The white globe on its curved arm and the horn speaker are at 5.4 m to 5.9 m.
The pole is a strong blue (#2f6aa8 in the sun), not light blue.

envelope.width.how: The frame looks 2.5 m to 3.2 m wide in photo 0 (it is seen at an angle, so one arm looks shorter); the drone photo (1) is too far to measure.

envelope.depth.how: The arms of the globe and the speaker reach about 0.3 m from the pole in photo 0; not measured from the side.
